facts.fact: 阿奇坚持送 Kiamling 回家，心里还改不掉旧称呼。
facts.anchor: Archie insisted on walking Miss Kim, no, Kiamling, home

facts.fact: 徐志海一路跟在另一侧，硬要跟上他们的步子。
facts.anchor: but for some reason that Hoi fellow loped along on the other side of her, trying to keep pace.

facts.fact: 在阿奇眼里，她一向更像隼，不像歌鸟。
facts.anchor: She had always been more of a falcon than a songbird

facts.fact: 徐志海用粤语说静玲一直担心她，语气阴沉，因为自己被冷落。
facts.anchor: “Jingling was worried about you,” Hoi gor interjected in Cantonese, sullen at being ignored.

facts.fact: 徐志海改用英语反击，说更多警察只会把看中的货物没收进自己人住的营房。
facts.anchor: “More constables confiscating goods that they fancy for their own quarters.” Hoi gor spoke in English.

facts.fact: 阿奇反问对方讲不讲操守，说他打听过商人徐志海的底细。
facts.anchor: “Oh, you want to discuss scruples? Because I asked around about the merchant Tsui Chihoi.

facts.fact: 启明喝止两人，她气息很浅，身体还因为仙灵界的遭遇而虚弱。
facts.anchor: “Stop it! Both of you.” Kiamling’s breath was shallow, her body still weak from what she had endured in the other realm.

facts.fact: 他翻出陶罐，找到一根干瘪的胡萝卜、一个洋葱和两个鸡蛋。
facts.anchor: He opened a couple of earthenware pots, found a shrivelled carrot and an onion, a couple of chicken eggs.

facts.fact: 她脖子到后背满是虫咬的红疹，伤口渗血。
facts.anchor: A rash of insect bites ran down her neck and back, weeping bloody sores.

facts.fact: 他劝她睡前把伤口洗干净，想装得随意却装不成。
facts.anchor: “You should wash them out before you sleep,” he said, trying and failing to keep his voice casual.

facts.fact: 她骂他笨蛋，用的词是 dunderhead。
facts.anchor: “Don’t be such a dunderhead.”

facts.fact: 她问这道菜叫什么，他说那不过是煎蛋卷。
facts.anchor: “Foo what? It’s an omelette.”

facts.fact: 看她吃的样子，他想把一整套体面规矩扔出窗外。
facts.anchor: Watching her made him want to throw the rules of decorum out the window.

facts.fact: 他自知在别人眼里是个想藏起出身的巫婆之子。
facts.anchor: A misfit son of a witch trying to hide his origins

facts.fact: 她说后背那道疤是一个靠得太近的女鬼留下的，怪自己莽撞。
facts.anchor: A geongsi who got too close. I was reckless.

facts.fact: 他讲英国的仙灵故事：棕精灵、地精、换生子、无头骑士，还有卡美洛与舍伍德。
facts.anchor: He told stories of fae; of brownies and boggarts; changelings and headless horsemen; of Camelot and Sherwood Forest.

facts.fact: 他劝她别在妹妹身上犯同样的错。
facts.anchor: “Don’t make the same mistake with your sister.”

facts.fact: 他低头要吻她时，十字架从衣领里滑出来朝她荡去。
facts.anchor: It was his crucifix, come free of his shirt and swinging towards Kiamling as he lowered his lips to hers.

facts.fact: 他在碰到口袋里那枚银豆之前收住了手，最终空着手。
facts.anchor: He caught himself before he touched it, still empty-handed.

facts.fact: 门在他身后砰地关上，他没有回头。
facts.anchor: The door banged in Archie’s wake, but he did not look back.
